decision_conditions: The applicant has failed to demonstrate, with the submission of satisfactory details, that the development will achieve an inclusive design,  present a satisfactory appearance, preserve and enhance the visual amenities of the locality and would not increase the risk of flooding in compliance with Policy BE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012), Policies DMHB 11, DMHB 12, DMHB 14, DMEI 1, DMEI 9, DMEI 10 and DMT 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020) and Policies D3, D5, D7 and  SI 13 of the London Plan (2021).
description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Conditions 3 (Step Free Access), 4 (M4(2) Dwelling Technical Specifications), 5 (Materials), 6 (Landscaping), 7 (Sustainable Water Management), 8 (Obscure Glazing), and 12 (Construction Management Plan) of planning permission ref. 51120/APP/2024/3016, dated 10-03-25 (Demolition of garage, partial demolition of existing rear extension and erection of a detached two storey 1-bed dwellinghouse with associated amenity space, vehicular parking and new crossover, bicycle and bin stores.)
